_comment: Shared fixtures for the vowelling gate mirror pair. Read by BOTH plan-dashboard/scripts/lib/vowelling.test.mjs and scripts/podcast/tests/test_vowelling.py, so a change to either implementation that is not matched in the other fails a test rather than letting the Composer's Diacritics button and the compose-time vowelling pass disagree about what may reach book.md. The gate is not about WHETHER to vowel (settled 2026-07-29: always) — it is the marks-only rule that keeps a model from moving letters under cover of marking them.

skeleton._why: Arabic-Indic digits must SURVIVE the skeleton. They sit inside the U+0653-U+0670 span an earlier literal character class used, so they were being stripped as if they were marks — which let a vowelling that deleted every footnote and verse number pass as marks-only.
skeleton.in: تأليف ١ سيدنا جعفر بن منصور ٢ اليمن٣
skeleton.out: تأليف ١ سيدنا جعفر بن منصور ٢ اليمن٣

markCount._why: fatha, kasra, shadda, fatha, damma — the shadda counts
digits are not marks — a bare line of them counts zero, or mark_density reads it as already vowelled and skips it
dotless beh and qaf are LETTERS that sit in the same span as the digits
Qur'anic annotation signs DO count — this range was in the JS half only until the two were unified

isCandidate._why: a bare passage of real length — the case the pass exists for
isCandidate.in: فإنه من عمل لله بما يعلم، هداه الله إلى ما لا يعلم

isCandidate._why: already vowelled (a Qur'anic run carries the mushaf's own marks)
too short to be a passage

isArabicPassage.in: فإنه من عمل لله بما يعلم

isArabicPassage._why: English prose quoting Arabic is not a passage to vowel
isArabicPassage.in: The Master said, quoting فإنه من عمل لله, that knowledge is given

isArabicPassage._why: one stray reference marker is tolerated
isArabicPassage.in: فإنه من عمل لله بما يعلم a

rejection.out: no Arabic script in the candidate

rejection._why: returned unchanged — no marks to show for the call
a word was dropped — letters moved, which the gate exists to catch
rejection.source: فإنه من عمل لله بما يعلم

rejection._why: the footnote digits were deleted while the words were vowelled. On a real OCR line this was ADMITTED before the mark-range fix, because skeleton() stripped the digits from both sides.
rejection.source: تأليف ١ سيدنا جعفر بن منصور ٢ اليمن٣
rejection.candidate: تَأْلِيف سَيِّدنَا جَعْفَر بْن مَنْصُور اليَمَن

_reflowComment: reflow_to_source_whitespace / reflowToSourceWhitespace. skeleton() collapses whitespace before comparing, so a model that returns a multi-line passage as one line passes the gate unnoticed. Line structure is load-bearing — produce_bilingual slices the Arabic source by line range — so the vowelling pass reflows a candidate onto the source's own whitespace BEFORE the gate sees it, rather than adding a clause that would refuse the 886-of-1395 runs that span lines.

reflow._why: the model collapsed three lines into one; the source's line breaks come back, and not one mark moves
reflow.source:
قال العالم
ودموعه تنحدر
على لحيته
reflow.candidate: قَالَ الْعَالِمُ وَدُمُوعُهُ تَنْحَدِرُ عَلَى لِحْيَتِهِ
reflow.out:
قَالَ الْعَالِمُ
وَدُمُوعُهُ تَنْحَدِرُ
عَلَى لِحْيَتِهِ

reflow._why: single-line in, single-line out — nothing to repair
digits survive a reflow in their original positions
skeletons disagree — hand the candidate back untouched so the gate reports the real reason

ORPHAN MARK. A scan can leave a combining mark with no letter under it — a real run in the Master-and-Disciple OCR begins with a bare sukun. Consuming that orphan AS a letter puts every later letter off by one, the walk runs off the end, and the repair gives up and returns the collapsed line. The gate cannot catch it: skeleton() has already normalised the whitespace away. This cost a 45-minute paid run. NOTE the orphan lands AFTER the space rather than before it: the source's own marks are skipped (the candidate re-supplies them) and the candidate's orphan is emitted when the walk next looks for a letter. The three invariants that matter all hold — line count, skeleton, and mark count — and shifting a letterless mark across adjacent whitespace changes nothing a reader or a downstream reader-of-lines can see.

_reflowWordsComment: reflow_words_to_source_whitespace / reflowWordsToSourceWhitespace. The mushaf joins a verse's words with single spaces, so a verse the book prints across two lines comes back as one and the file loses a line. The character-level reflow cannot repair it — Uthmani letters legitimately differ, so the skeletons do not match and it correctly declines. Word alignment is safe here precisely because the mushaf lookup is itself word-aligned.

reflowWords._why: a two-line verse restored from the mushaf keeps its line break
word counts disagree — hand it back rather than reshape text to fit

_transferComment: transferMarks / transfer_marks: the source's letters wearing the candidate's marks. Every 'out' here is a REAL refusal recorded in content/*/_system/book-vowelling.json before 2026-08-11, when a refusal was terminal and the run stayed bare. null means the two cannot be aligned and the gate must still refuse — a mark placed on a word the model misread is a wrong reading printed confidently.

transfer._why: the Urdu teh marbuta the model normalised to the Arabic one — spiritual-ethos
a hamza the source does not carry, plus two Perso-Arabic letters — the commonest refusal of all
a hamza the model puts on a waw — the same class as the alif above, found by re-running the backfill
nothing to fold: the candidate already agrees, so the marks land unchanged
a different word, same length — refused, or a mark would land on a misreading
a dropped clause — refused on the letter count alone
he and teh marbuta are NOT one family: in Arabic that is a spelling difference
